data.narrative:
Starcloud is a SPAC-stage space and aerospace company founded by Philip Johnston, Ezra Feilden, and Adi Oltean, currently valued at $1.1B after raising $170M. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 13 companies across public and private markets in the Space & Aerospace sector.

The primary applicable method is peer-median triangulation, based on eight same-sector peers at similar valuation tiers. These peers—including Impulse Space ($4.3B), Firefly Aerospace ($2.9B), Apex Space ($2.3B), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B), and Varda Space Industries ($1.6B)—yield a median valuation of $1.8B, with a range spanning $840M to $4.3B. Public-comp anchoring using a 27.4x price-to-sales multiple across six public Space & Aerospace tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) is not applicable, as Starcloud's revenue has not been disclosed.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.5B to $2.1B, with a median of $1.8B. The current $1.1B valuation sits below the peer median by approximately 39%. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory and the representativeness of the peer set given stage-heterogeneity within the sample (ranging from Series B to public). The analysis is constrained by reliance on a single applicable method; revenue disclosure would enable cross-validation via public-market multiples.
